question: Is this the same as renting a house from you?
answer: No. If we sell you a home, you are buying it. You and we sign a note for that house: a purchase price, a down payment, a monthly payment, and a length of time, usually 15 to 30 years. You are not signing a lease with us. The How It Works page walks through how that compares with renting.

question: Do I need a bank loan?
answer: Not for the house payment. Owner financing means we hold the note and you pay us. You still want to understand taxes, insurance, and repairs. We will go through those for the specific house before you sign.

question: If I fill out a form, am I approved?
answer: No. A form tells us you want to talk. We look at each person and each house. Some conversations turn into a sale. Some don't. We will tell you where things stand, and we will not pretend a website button is a yes.

question: How much money do I need to move in?
answer: It depends on the house. When we have set a down payment, it is on that home's page. If you see TBD, we have not set that figure yet, and we are not hiding a price. Tell us what you can actually bring, and we will tell you whether it fits a home we have.

question: What does the monthly payment cover?
answer: The note names the payment and what it applies to. Taxes and insurance may be inside that number or on top of it, and that can differ by house. Ask us, and read that part of the paperwork before you sign. We will not guess at it here.

question: Can I see a house before I decide?
answer: Yes. Please do. Use Book a Tour and tell us which days and times usually work. We will call to confirm. Picking a time on the form is a request, not an appointment, until we talk.

question: What if my credit isn't perfect?
answer: Call us anyway and tell us the truth. We make our own decision, house by house. That is not a promise that every situation works. It is a promise that a rough credit history, by itself, is not a reason to stay quiet.

question: Where are the homes?
answer: We work in southern Illinois, around Murphysboro. Right now there is one home on this site: 426 North Street in Murphysboro. When we have another, it will show up on Find a Home. You can also get on the list and we will reach out.

question: Who will I actually talk to?
answer: Gregg or Kristi. This is a husband-and-wife company, and we answer the phone. If we are walking a house with someone, leave a message or send the form and we will get back to you.

question: I have a house I want to sell. Do you buy those?
answer: Often, yes. We buy houses for cash, as-is, in any condition, around southern Illinois. Start on the Sell Us Your House page. A conversation is not a contract, and you can say no to an offer.
